message: For this synthetic demonstration, adopt the illustrative aluminum values E=69000 MPa, Poisson ratio 0.33, yield strength 240 MPa and density 2700 kg/m3. Fully fix the entire rear X=0 face in XYZ. Apply a TOTAL [0,0,-150] N uniformly across the selected X=80 end face, replacing the previous 100 N force. Both bores stay free. Assume steady room-temperature small-strain linear static loading, no self-weight, no contact, bolts or preload. No acceptance threshold is specified; this is a demonstration, not physical approval. Keep the current geometry and propose the complete setup for visual review.
